title: Is it Possible to Fetch user Information?

posts.author: Robbie626
posts.body:
For context, I have a forum site using PhpBB and I am creating mini-games for users to play and take screenshots to save their score.  So far I am using a variable where users can input a code to verify they are not reusing scorres (whoever they send would give them a unique code). I want to be more effectively to see if there is a way using javascript to fetch information to display ad a variable in the event when the game event trigger occurs to let them screenshot.
Can I use Javascript and display variable for the current Date and Time?
Can I use a script where they can fetch the username from MySQL database (I do host the games on my hosted server.
I want to find a more effective way to prevent my users from cheating.

posts.author: Mac15001900
posts.body:
Robbie626 said:
I want to find a more effective way to prevent my users from cheating.
Click to expand...
That's generally not something you can effectively do. Your game's code is easily available to them, and anyone familiar with JavaScript (not even with RPG Maker itself) will usually be able to grant themself console access and make their score whatever they want.
Though of course you can make cheating harder - just bear in mind that it won't be too hard.
Robbie626 said:
Can I use Javascript and display variable for the current Date and Time?
Click to expand...
Sure, just use
new Date()
.
Robbie626 said:
Can I use a script where they can fetch the username from MySQL database (I do host the games on my hosted server.
Click to expand...
That's trickier. What you
really
don't want to do is to connect to the database directly from the game, since that requires leaving the credentials within it - this would allow anyone to not just submit arbitrary scores, but take control over the whole database.
You'd generally want the game to connect to a server you control, and that server to handle communicating with the database. Alternatively, use Firebase or a similar database meant to be used with static websites.
